binary_format.layout: all integers u32 little-endian: magic(8 bytes) | n_wires | n_gates | n_input_decls | n_output_decls | n_layers | gates: n_gates x (op, a, b, out) with op 0 XOR, 1 AND, 2 NOT (b = a) | layers: n_layers x (start, end) gate-index ranges of the AND layers | inputs: (owner, label_len, label utf-8, width, wires[width]) with owner 0, 1, 2 = BOUND | outputs: same with owner 0, 1, 2 = PUBLIC, 3 = RETAIN. Wires 0 and 1 are the constants 0 and 1; inputs follow in declaration order; gate i drives wire 2 + n_inputs + i. Gate order: [linear][AND layer 1][linear][AND layer 2]...

bristol_format: Bristol Fashion; gates XOR, AND, INV only; input values ordered party 0, party 1, bound; one output value per output declaration; bit vectors little-endian; see bristol_layout of each entry for labels, owners and offsets
